        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G), G['Demo pair 1 input'][22:26])

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[r for r in range(h) if all(c==2 for c in g[r])]
    rl=line[0]
    shape=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (bg,2)]
    rs=[r for r,c in shape]; top,bot=min(rs),max(rs)
    hh=bot-top+1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c in shape: out[r][c]=bg
    if top>rl:  # shape below line
        ntop=rl+1
        out[rl+1+hh][:]=8
    else:
        ntop=rl-1-(hh-1)
        out[rl-1-hh][:]=8
    for r,c in shape: out[r-top+ntop][c]=g[r][c]
    return out
o=transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(o==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
